description: PV in the Circular Economy, Dynamic Energy and Materials TOOL (PV_ICE) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by not stated on the factsheet. This open-source tool implements Circular Economy metrics for photovoltaic (PV) materials. It can be used to quantify and assign a value framework to efforts on re-design, reduction, replacement, reuse, recycling, and lifetime and reliability increases in the PV value chain. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: LCA, Materials. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD 3-clause Clear license. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
